breaking.change: Controllers move before rigid-body substeps, publish poses sequentially, and exclusively own dynamic pushing. Teleports no longer become kinematic sweeps.
breaking.fix: Read controller and sensor results on the next game tick as before; set pushBodies, mass and pushStrength explicitly for virtual pushing.

breaking.change: Dynamic pushing uses virtual controller mass, contact-point effective mass and torque, with a shared pushStrength impulse budget. Standing applies controller weight at the support point. Both new mass fields default to zero and push nothing.
breaking.fix: Set mass in kg, pushBodies true and pushStrength in N to enable pushing; retune old forces that depended on infinite kinematic mass.

breaking.member: CharacterController.up, addVelocity, jumpBuffer, buffer, inheritedVelocity, platformInherit; PlatformerController.platformInherit
breaking.change: Characters use an explicit up axis for grounding, slopes and jumping; zero disables grounded movement. Added velocity is consumed once; jumpBuffer holds presses; platformInherit controls momentum on leaving support. New numbers default to zero (off).
breaking.fix: Set up to (0,1,0) for ordinary walking or to the desired nonzero up axis. Set jumpBuffer seconds and platformInherit share explicitly; use addVelocity for springs and knockback. Do not write buffer or inheritedVelocity.

breaking.fix: Use ground for the supporting collider, groundBody for its parent; leave support points and frames to physics. Do not add platform velocity to CharacterController.velocity again.

breaking.fix: Remove dropTime reads and writes; read droppingThrough instead. Set wallCoyoteTime to enable grace after leaving a wall and leave wallCoyote/lastWall to physics.
